primary_biological_variables.matched_definition: Fallback category for studies where no clear perturbation or differential treatment axis is present in the proteomics comparison. This is not a mapping error when supported by evidence.
evidence: This study evaluates and compares various cell lysis and protein digestion protocols for bottom-up proteomics using HeLa S3 cells.
Our goal was to determine what unique proteins, if any, were identified in each digestion method.

replicate_hints: Each protocol had five replicates, all from the same cell pellet, for statistical analysis purposes.
evidence: We assessed two physical disruption methods to homogenize cells—sonication and BeatBox—alongside four digestion protocols.

Two of them are lab-reagent strategies: urea-based and sodium deoxycholate (SDC)-based in-solution digestion, and two are commercially available kits: the EasyPep kit from Thermo Fisher Scientific and S-Trap from Protifi.

we performed a DE analysis with each digestion method compared to each other digestion method.
